title: Monarch CLI normalized transaction (v1)
description: Normative contract for one normalized transaction record in list output (`monarch transactions list`) and other transaction collections. The richer single-transaction detail shape is published as urn:monarch-cli:schema:transaction-detail:v1. Fields are always present; unavailable values are null; is_pending and needs_review are always booleans. Additive-only: new optional properties may be added without a version change, but removing or renaming a property, narrowing nullability, tightening a type, or adding a required property requires a new schema version.

amount.description: Transaction amount; negative is an expense, positive is income. Never fabricated as 0.

description.description: Deterministic description: merchant.name, then plaidName, else null.

is_pending.description: True while the upstream transaction is pending. Absent or null upstream values default to false.

needs_review.description: Whether the transaction needs review. Absent or null upstream values default to false.

review_status.description: Opaque upstream review status; null when omitted by the selected endpoint.

owner_id.description: Upstream ownedByUser.id, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

owner_name.description: Upstream ownedByUser.name, or null when no owner relationship was provided.

ownership_overridden_at.description: Literal upstream ownershipOverriddenAt timestamp; proves only that an override occurred.
